Nice catch — this is a common forwarding artifact. Two quick suggestions:
1) Use the recreated invite as the canonical event and mark the forwarded one as "cancelled" so attendees don’t accidentally accept the stale token.
2) For external orgs with tight SAML windows, include the Zoom fallback in the top-level description and also add the Zoom meeting as a separate calendar event (invite-only) for the vendor guests.

Proposed options to send to Sam: 2:30–3:00pm PT (preferred) or 3:00–3:30pm PT (fallback). If we have more than 6 participants, propose 45m and we’ll tighten the agenda.

On operational note: Priyom — could you prep a one-paragraph SSO troubleshooting blurb I can paste into the invite if Eric hits the block? Just a checklist: clear cache, try the Zoom fallback, ask IT to allow redirecting organizer tokens from redwood.ai.

Ben
